orientation.comparisonLimit: Horizons quantity 14 was geocentric and its Mars longitude west-positive; local model is Shenzhen topocentric. The supplied JPL latitude is planetographic, so latitude was not used as a planetocentric gold check.

sourceMapCoordinateProbe.method: For the USGS WMS -180..180 east-positive, 90..-90 planetocentric 1024x512 export, project IAU feature coordinates to raster x/y; inspect the original JPEG visually and decode 41x41 luma regions using the already installed jpeg-js package. Hellas is the prominent bright basin around the predicted raster region, unlike its longitude mirror; Olympus region also contains the expected small light feature. This checks the source raster's coarse axis/hemisphere registration, not exact landmark centroid or GPU shader pixels.
sourceMapCoordinateProbe.webglConvention: https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/ documents default UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL=false and DOM source first pixel at upper left; existing image upload and shader UV were checked against that convention, but native Mars pixels have not been observed.
